source_text.body:
Track tasks, research ideas and review crypto history with Grok Bot
The poster uses Grok Bot to sort and track tasks, research business ideas, help with YouTube editing and make sense of four years of Binance history.
·
Nov 3, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The poster spent two weeks using Grok Bot as a “second brain,” dumping ideas and tasks into it in their native language so it sorted and tracked them while replying in English. They also set up multiple assistants with an org chart, action board, and daily status board for business research, channel growth, YouTube editing, and app coding in the cloud from their phone; for the app, they say they reviewed every change before it went live.
How it went
The clearest result was on Binance records: after giving Grok four years of exports, they say it produced an interactive dashboard within a few hours, rebuilt account history, found where losses came from, and flagged remaining gaps needing their input. The post does not give hard performance metrics beyond time saved.
Worth knowing
Their main practical catch is cost: one commenter called Grok Bot expensive, and the poster replied that it was worth it for the speed and value.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Help me organize my life and projects. Sort this list of tasks into priorities and set up a simple tracker I can check each day: [paste tasks]. Then research [business idea] and give me a one-page summary of the market, competitors, and a first step, and go through my exported [exchange name] transaction history in [file] to summarize my trades, gains and losses by year. Don't take any actions on my accounts, just report.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xjqka0/i_finally_get_the_grok_bot_hype_is_there
